meta.title: Multiplicity
meta.author: liqube
meta.description: The soundtrack of Multiplicity by liqube (2021-04-04). 32K executable music that placed 4th in the executable music competition at Revision Online 2021. 130 BPM, 4:00, 31 tracks, 5138 notes. Instruments: 15 Falcon (FM synth), 6 Slaughter (subtractive synth), 4 Adultery (GM.DLS sampler), 1 Specimen (GSM sampler). Effects: 13 Scissor, 20 Leveller, 6 Crusher, 6 Echo, 12 Smasher, 2 Chamber, 2 Twister, 3 Cathedral. Its Adultery instruments play waves from the Windows GM.DLS bank: they sound as intended only with that bank (GM_DLS=<path to gm.dls>); macOS's own GS bank has other waves. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: the WaveSabre song was read from the running executable's memory (tools/ws-extract, Wine), converted by `synth-convert ws` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64, effects 65-73) and imported with `song import` (lanes cut into 2-, 4- or 8-bar patterns, notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat). Against the bit-exact WaveSabre port it differs by +0.05 dB loudness and at most 0.21 dB in any octave band from 63 Hz to 8 kHz (16 kHz up to 3 dB brighter, a known difference of the unified engine). Track names are derived here from each track's instrument and notes; the executable does not store the authors' names. No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
